medals.name: Combat Veteran
medals.desc: Awarded to distinguished combat veterans after playing 250 games.

medals.name: Combat Action Badge
medals.desc: Awarded to soldiers who attain over 1300 kills and 10 massive kills in a single game.

medals.name: Expert Medic Badge
medals.desc: Awarded to exceptional combat medics who heal 22 times in a single game.

medals.name: Bronze Star
medals.desc:
Hard completed with 0 deaths, = 800 kills, >=5 massive kills and IL < 40.

Alligator not eligible.

medals.name: Silver Star
medals.desc:
Insane completed with 0 deaths, = 1000 kills, 8 massive kills and IL < 40.

Alligator not eligible.

medals.name: Gold Star
medals.desc:
NM completed with 0 deaths, = 1200 kills, 10 massive kills and IL < 40.

Alligator not eligible.

medals.name: Combat Proficiency Badge
medals.desc: Awarded to soldiers who win 4 rounds in competitive mode.

medals.name: Purple Heart
medals.desc: Sustain 20 hits and 2 deaths in a single game.

medals.name: Medal of Valor
medals.desc: Awarded to medics who revive 12 times in a single game.

medals.name: Good Conduct Medal
medals.desc:
Save every refugee during the Valor chapter on normal or harder difficulty.
(the medal is failed if any civilian dies during the Valor Chapter)

medals.name: Sharpshooter Medal
medals.desc: Attain 50+ massive kills in a game on hard+ difficulty (PMC mode not allowed).

medals.name: Expert Marksman Badge
medals.desc: Complete the PMC -rifle epilogue with 50+ PMC kills, have to detain the Dr Jashan.

decals.name: Bear Claw
decals.req: Win Insane mode with Rifle modifier and 2-4 players only.

decals.name: Cavalry Sabers
decals.req: Win Nightmare mode as a Cavalry Scout.

decals.name: RA
decals.req: Win PMC mode with 1 life modifier.

decals.name: Wolves
decals.req: Win Nightmare mode with 2-4 players only.

decals.name: Fire Hound
decals.req: Get every unlocks of the Combat Walker.

decals.name: Black Wings
decals.req: Get every unlocks of the Alligator.

decals.name: White moon
decals.req: Get every unlocks of the Assault Engineer (Predator).

camos.name: Olive
camos.req: Play 75 games (a game is considered played at 300s).

camos.name: Red Tiger
camos.req: Win Hard+ mode with Rifle modifier.

camos.name: SAS
camos.req: Win Survival mode with Rifle modifier.

camos.name: Woodland Tiger
camos.req: Win Hard+ mode without dying and being hit.

camos.name: Chameleon
camos.req: Win Nightmare mode with 1 life modifier.

camos.name: OctoCamo
camos.req: Win PMC mode with Rifle modifier.

camos.name: Medic
camos.req: Win Insane+ mode as a medic.

camos.name: Desert
camos.req: Win Survival mode with 2-4 players (Outbreak modifier excluded).

camos.name: Nano
camos.req: Win Nightmare mode with a Ghost, a Cyborg or a Prototype.

camos.name: ABU
camos.req: Win Survival mode with Tier 1 modifier.

camos.name: Tech
camos.req: Win Hard+ mode as an engineer.
